Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[{"step": 1, "file": "src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 30, "var": "Data", "code": "config_open_path(config, filename)", "note": "Fuzzer input Data is written to a temp file and passed to config_open_path, which mmaps it into memory as the config buffer."}, {"step": 2, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_config", "line": 649, "var": "lexer->pos", "code": "if (chr == '\\'' && !strncmp(lexer->pos, \"''\", 2)) return lex_multiline_string;", "note": "lex_config reads the first single-quote character, then confirms the next two characters are also quotes, routing to lex_multiline_string. lexer->pos now points past the first quote."}, {"step": 3, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_multiline_string", "line": 157, "var": "lexer->pos", "code": "advance_n(lexer, strlen(\"'''\") - 1);", "note": "advance_n moves lexer->pos forward by 2 bytes, placing it at the end of the 3-byte input buffer (past the third quote)."}, {"step": 4, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_multiline_string", "line": 160, "var": "lexer->pos", "code": "if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3))", "note": "strncmp reads 3 bytes from lexer->pos, which is at the buffer boundary. Since the input is exactly 3 bytes, this reads 3 bytes past the end of the buffer, causing a global-buffer-overflow READ."}]
EOF
echo "Created candidate_trace.json"` executed with exit code 0.
